technology_name: PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA MEDIATED SYNTHESIS OF WATER SOLUBLE COLLOIDAL QUANTUM DOTS FOR PHOTOCATALYTIC REDUCTION OF CHROMIUM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Synthesizing heavy-metal water treatment catalysts typically requires harsh, toxic organic chemical stabilizing compounds that generate secondary environment pollution risks.
description: A single-step, bio-mediated synthesis protocol leveraging active Pseudomonas aeruginosa bacterial strains to grow completely water-soluble cadmium sulfide colloidal quantum dots ($CdS\text{-}QDs$) optimized to reduce toxic $Cr(VI)$ into safe $Cr(III)$ under visible light.
applications: Industrial electroplating wastewater remediation, heavy metal effluent processing nodes, municipal chemical filtration basins, and toxic chemical reclamation zones.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
